terms.title: Terms of Use
terms.intro: Please read and accept these terms to use Ghostr. They exist to keep the service safe for everyone.
terms.s1Body: By using Ghostr you agree to these Terms of Use. If you do not agree, do not use the app.
terms.s2Body: Ghostr is an end-to-end encrypted messenger. There are no accounts: your identity and your messages exist only on your device, and conversations are created by invitation only. You are solely responsible for the content you send.
terms.s3Body: There is no tolerance for objectionable content or abusive users on Ghostr. This includes harassment, threats, hate speech, sexual exploitation, illegal content and spam. Reports are reviewed and acted upon within 24 hours: offending content is removed and abusive users permanently lose the ability to contact their victims.
terms.s4Body: You can report any received message (long-press → Report) and block a contact at any time (contact info → Block and report). Blocking immediately deletes the conversation from your device and permanently prevents the blocked contact from contacting you again. Reports are transmitted to moderation only with your explicit consent.
terms.s5Body: Messages are end-to-end encrypted; the servers cannot read them. When you report content, only what you choose to report is transmitted to moderation, without your IP address or identity.
terms.s6Body: Ghostr is provided "as is", without warranty of any kind. To the maximum extent permitted by law, its authors cannot be held liable for damages resulting from the use of the app.
terms.s7Body: Questions or reports of inappropriate behavior: theghostr.com
terms.contactError: Could not open your email app. Write to support@theghostr.com.
terms.acceptNote: By tapping "Accept and continue", you confirm that you have read and agree to these terms.

migrationLockdown.footer: No messages can be sent or received on this device while it's frozen.

migrationLockdown.wipeIrreversibleBody: All messages, keys and settings will be deleted. ONLY do this AFTER you have successfully restored on your new device.

migrationLockdown.cancelDangerBody: ONLY cancel if you have NOT yet completed the import on the new device. Otherwise, both devices will send incompatible messages and some conversations will break.
